u3-l1.kupelna.note.en: In Slovak homes the toilet (WC) is often a separate little room.
u3-l1.kupelna.note.t: Slovakiyadagi uylarda hojatxona (WC) koʻpincha alohida kichik xonada boʻladi.

u3-l1.hore-dole.note.en: Also simply up and down. Kuchyňa je **hore**. = The kitchen is upstairs.
u3-l1.hore-dole.note.t: Oddiy «tepada – pastda» maʼnosida ham ishlatiladi. Kuchyňa je **hore**. = Oshxona yuqorida.

u3-l1.choice-kuchyna-je-dole.question.en: How do you say “The kitchen is downstairs”?

u3-l1.vratnica.note.en: The desk at the entrance, where the porter (**vrátnik**) sits. In Emma's dorm, that's pán Kováč.
u3-l1.vratnica.note.t: Kirishdagi stol, u yerda qorovul (**vrátnik**) oʻtiradi. Emmaning yotoqxonasida bu — janob Kovach.

u3-l1.byvam-na-internate.note.en: **internát** = student dormitory. Emma and Lucia share a room there.
u3-l1.byvam-na-internate.note.t: **internát** = talabalar yotoqxonasi. Emma va Lusiya u yerda bitta xonada yashashadi.

en: The bathroom is **kúpeľňa**. Kuchyňa looks similar, but it's the kitchen.
Where? is **kde**, and it starts the question. Hore means upstairs: it's an answer, as in Kúpeľňa je hore.
t: «Vannaxona» — **kúpeľňa**. Kuchyňa unga oʻxshab koʻrinadi, lekin u «oshxona» degani.
«Qayerda?» — **kde**, savol shu soʻz bilan boshlanadi. Hore esa «yuqorida»: bu javob, masalan Kúpeľňa je hore.

en: The room is upstairs and the kitchen is downstairs.
The room is upstairs and the kitchen downstairs.
Emma is **ona**, and with on or ona the verb has no ending: **býva**. Bývam, with -m, is ja (I).
To say where someone lives, use **býva**, like bývam (I live). Je (is) only says where Emma is right now.
t: Emma haqida «u» — **ona**, on yoki ona bilan esa feʼl qoʻshimchasiz keladi: **býva**. -m bilan bývam — ja (men) shakli.
Qayerda yashashni aytish uchun **býva** ishlatiladi, xuddi bývam (yashayman) kabi. Je esa faqat Emma hozir qayerdaligini bildiradi.

u3-l1.choice-kuchyna.question.en: Lucia wants to cook. Where does she go?
u3-l1.choice-kuchyna.question.t: Lusiya ovqat pishirmoqchi. U qayerga boradi?

en: An adjective takes the gender of its noun: **-ý** for masculine, **-á** for feminine, **-é** for neuter.
The ending is the same before the noun (malá izba) and after je (Izba je malá).
t: Sifat oʻz otining jinsiga moslashadi: erkak jinsi uchun **-ý**, ayol jinsi uchun **-á**, oʻrta jins uchun **-é**. Oʻzbekchada sifat oʻzgarmaydi (katta xona, katta mashina), slovakchada esa oʻzgaradi.
Qoʻshimcha ot oldida ham (malá izba), je soʻzidan keyin ham (Izba je malá) bir xil boʻladi.

u3-l2.fill-izba-je-velka.why.en: Izba ends in -a, so it's feminine and the adjective takes **-á**: veľk**á**. The ending is the same after je as before the noun.
u3-l2.fill-izba-je-velka.why.t: Izba -a bilan tugaydi, demak ayol jinsida, sifat esa **-á** oladi: veľk**á**. je soʻzidan keyin ham qoʻshimcha ot oldidagidek boʻladi.

u3-l2.fill-balkon-je-maly.why.en: Balkón ends in a consonant, so it's masculine and takes **-ý**: mal**ý**. Malá goes with feminine nouns like izba, malé with neuter ones like auto.
u3-l2.fill-balkon-je-maly.why.t: Balkón undosh bilan tugaydi, demak erkak jinsida va **-ý** oladi: mal**ý**. Malá izba kabi ayol jinsidagi, malé esa auto kabi oʻrta jinsdagi otlar bilan keladi.

u3-l2.choice-nova-kuchyna.why.en: Kuchyňa ends in -a, so it's feminine and the adjective takes **-á**: nov**á**. Nový goes with masculine nouns, nové with neuter ones.
u3-l2.choice-nova-kuchyna.why.t: Kuchyňa -a bilan tugaydi, demak ayol jinsida, sifat esa **-á** oladi: nov**á**. Nový erkak jinsi, nové esa oʻrta jins uchun.

u3-l2.maly-ale-pekny.note.en: **pekný** = nice, pretty. **ale** = but. Pekný works the same way: pekn**á** izba.
u3-l2.maly-ale-pekny.note.t: **pekný** = chiroyli, yaxshi. **ale** = lekin. Pekný ham xuddi shunday oʻzgaradi: pekn**á** izba.

en: Kuchyňa ends in -a, so it's feminine and the adjective takes **-á**: veľk**á**. Veľký is for masculine nouns.
The adjective matches kuchyňa, a feminine noun, so it ends in **-á**: veľk**á**. Veľké is for neuter nouns like auto.
t: Kuchyňa -a bilan tugaydi, demak ayol jinsida, sifat esa **-á** oladi: veľk**á**. Veľký erkak jinsidagi otlar uchun.
Sifat oʻz otiga — ayol jinsidagi kuchyňa soʻziga moslashadi, shuning uchun **-á** bilan tugaydi: veľk**á**. Veľké esa auto kabi oʻrta jinsdagi otlar uchun.

u3-l2.listen-izba-je-mala.en.en: The room is small but nice.

en: To ask what something is like, use **aký?** It changes just like an adjective: **aký** (masculine), **aká** (feminine), **aké** (neuter).
t: Biror narsa qandayligini soʻrash uchun **aký?** ishlatiladi. U ham sifat kabi oʻzgaradi: **aký** (erkak jinsi), **aká** (ayol jinsi), **aké** (oʻrta jins).

u3-l2.fill-aka-je-kupelna.why.en: **Aký?** changes like an adjective. Kúpeľňa ends in -a, so it's feminine: **aká**.
u3-l2.fill-aka-je-kupelna.why.t: **Aký?** ham sifat kabi oʻzgaradi. Kúpeľňa -a bilan tugaydi, demak ayol jinsida: **aká**.

u3-l2.choice-aky-je-balkon.why.en: **Aký?** asks what something is like. Where? is **kde**: Kde je balkón?
u3-l2.choice-aky-je-balkon.why.t: **Aký?** narsa qandayligini soʻraydi. «Qayerda?» esa **kde**: Kde je balkón?

u3-l2.fill-ake-je-auto.en.en: What's the car like? – It's old.

u3-l2.fill-ake-je-auto.why.en: Auto ends in -o, so it's neuter and takes **-é**: star**é**. The question already shows it: **aké** je auto.
u3-l2.fill-ake-je-auto.why.t: Auto -o bilan tugaydi, demak oʻrta jinsda va **-é** oladi: star**é**. Savol ham buni koʻrsatib turibdi: **aké** je auto.

en: **Aký?** changes like an adjective. Internát ends in a consonant, so it's masculine: **aký**. Aká is for feminine nouns.
“What is it like?” is **aký?** Kde asks where: Kde je internát?
t: **Aký?** sifat kabi oʻzgaradi. Internát undosh bilan tugaydi, demak erkak jinsida: **aký**. Aká ayol jinsidagi otlar uchun.
«Qanday?» — **aký?** Kde esa «qayerda?» deb soʻraydi: Kde je internát?

en: The kitchen is old but nice.
The kitchen is old but pretty.

u3-l2.fill-internat-je-velky.en.en: The dorm is big, but the kitchen is small.

u3-l2.fill-internat-je-velky.why.en: Each adjective matches its own noun. Kuchyňa is feminine, so **malá**, even though veľký before it goes with internát, which is masculine.
u3-l2.fill-internat-je-velky.why.t: Har bir sifat oʻz otiga moslashadi. Kuchyňa ayol jinsida, shuning uchun **malá**. Oldingi veľký esa erkak jinsidagi internát bilan keladi.

u3-l2.speak-izba-je-velka.en.en: The room is big and nice.

u3-aky-je.aky-je-tomas.note.en: **Aký?** asks about people too: what they're like as a person. The adjective matches the person: Tomáš je mil**ý**, Lucia je mil**á**.
u3-aky-je.aky-je-tomas.note.t: **Aký?** bilan odamlar haqida ham soʻraladi: u qanday odam. Sifat odamning jinsiga moslashadi: Tomáš je mil**ý** (erkak), Lucia je mil**á** (ayol).

u3-aky-je.mily-a-sympaticky.note.en: **milý** = kind, sweet; **sympatický** = likeable, someone you warm to.
u3-aky-je.mily-a-sympaticky.note.t: **milý** = mehribon, shirin (odam haqida); **sympatický** = yoqimli, darrov yoqib qoladigan odam.

u3-aky-je.fill-lucia-je-vesela.why.en: Lucia is a woman, so the adjective takes the feminine **-á**: vesel**á**. Veselý would be for Tomáš.
u3-aky-je.fill-lucia-je-vesela.why.t: Lusiya — ayol, shuning uchun sifat ayol jinsi qoʻshimchasi **-á** ni oladi: vesel**á**. Veselý esa Tomash uchun boʻlardi.

u3-aky-je.mudry-a-hlupy.note.en: After a long syllable (mú-, hlú-) the ending is short: múdr**y**, and for a woman múdr**a**, hlúp**a**.
u3-aky-je.mudry-a-hlupy.note.t: Choʻziq boʻgʻindan (mú-, hlú-) keyin qoʻshimcha qisqa boʻladi: múdr**y**, ayol uchun esa múdr**a**, hlúp**a**.

u3-aky-je.silny-a-slaby.note.en: Two more opposites: **rýchly – pomalý** (fast – slow). Rýchly has a short ending too: rýchl**a**.
u3-aky-je.silny-a-slaby.note.t: Yana ikkita qarama-qarshi soʻz: **rýchly – pomalý** (tez – sekin). Rýchly ham qisqa qoʻshimcha oladi: rýchl**a**.

u3-aky-je.fill-pani-horvathova-je-mudra..en: Pani Horváthová is a woman, so the adjective is feminine: **múdra**, with a short -a after the long ú.
u3-aky-je.fill-pani-horvathova-je-mudra..t: Horvatova xonim — ayol, shuning uchun sifat ayol jinsida keladi: **múdra**. Choʻziq ú harfidan keyin qoʻshimcha qisqa boʻladi: -a, -á emas.

u3-aky-je.fill-marek-je-mily.why.en: Marek is a man, so the adjective takes the masculine **-ý**, just like sympatick**ý** after it: mil**ý**.
u3-aky-je.fill-marek-je-mily.why.t: Marek — erkak, shuning uchun sifat erkak jinsi qoʻshimchasi **-ý** ni oladi, undan keyingi sympatick**ý** kabi: mil**ý**.

en: Emma is a woman, so the adjective takes the feminine **-á**: vesel**á**. Veselý is for a man.
Emma is a woman, so it's **milá**. Milé is the neuter form, for words like auto.
t: Emma — ayol, shuning uchun sifat ayol jinsi qoʻshimchasi **-á** ni oladi: vesel**á**. Veselý — erkak uchun.
Emma — ayol, shuning uchun **milá**. Milé — oʻrta jins shakli, auto kabi soʻzlar uchun.

u3-aky-je.choice-emma-nie-je-smutna.why.en: Emma is a woman, so the adjective is **smutná**, and for one person byť is **je**: nie je. Smutný is masculine; nie sú is for oni.
u3-aky-je.choice-emma-nie-je-smutna.why.t: Emma — ayol, shuning uchun sifat **smutná** boʻladi, bitta kishi uchun byť esa **je**: nie je. Smutný — erkak jinsi, nie sú esa oni (ular) uchun.

en: What's Mr Kováč like? He's kind and strong.
What is Mr Kováč like? He is kind and strong.
What's Mr Kováč like? He's nice and strong.
What is Mr Kováč like? He is nice and strong.
t: Janob Kovach qanday odam? U mehribon va kuchli.
Janob Kovach qanday odam? Mehribon va kuchli.
Janob Kovach qanday? U mehribon va kuchli.
Janob Kovach qanday? Mehribon va kuchli.
Janob Kovach qanday odam? U yoqimli va kuchli.
Janob Kovach qanday odam? Yoqimli va kuchli.

u3-l3.postel.note.en: Posteľ is feminine, even without -a: posteľ je mal**á**.
u3-l3.postel.note.t: Posteľ ayol jinsida, garchi -a bilan tugamasa ham: posteľ je mal**á**.

u3-l3.okno.note.en: Okno is neuter, like auto: okno je veľk**é**.
u3-l3.okno.note.t: Okno oʻrta jinsda, xuddi auto kabi: okno je veľk**é**.

u3-l3.vlavo-vpravo.en.en: on the left – on the right

u3-l3.fill-stol-je-vlavo.en.en: The desk is on the left.

u3-l3.listen-lampa-je-vpravo.en.en: The lamp is on the right.

u3-l3.vpredu-vzadu.en.en: at the front – at the back

u3-l3.choice-skrina-je-vzadu.question.en: How do you say “The wardrobe is at the back”?

u3-l3.build-stol-je-vlavo.prompt.en: The desk is on the left and the bed is on the right.

u3-l3.fill-okno-je-velke.why.en: Okno ends in -o, so it's neuter, like auto, and takes **-é**: veľk**é**.
u3-l3.fill-okno-je-velke.why.t: Okno -o bilan tugaydi, demak auto kabi oʻrta jinsda va **-é** oladi: veľk**é**.

u3-l3.fill-postel-je-nova.why.en: Posteľ ends in a consonant but is feminine, so the adjective takes **-á**: nov**á**.
u3-l3.fill-postel-je-nova.why.t: Posteľ undosh bilan tugasa ham, ayol jinsida, shuning uchun sifat **-á** oladi: nov**á**. Bu soʻzni jinsi bilan yodlab qoʻying.

en: The room is small but the window is big.
The room is small but the window is large.

u3-l3.speak-lampa-je-vlavo.en.en: The lamp is on the left.

en: Possessives match the gender of the thing owned, just like adjectives: môj stôl, moj**a** izba, moj**e** okno.
Watch the vowel: m**ô**j but m**o**ja, n**á**š but n**a**ša. Use **tvoj** with ty and **váš** with vy.
t: Egalik olmoshlari ham, sifatlar kabi, narsaning jinsiga moslashadi: môj stôl, moj**a** izba, moj**e** okno. Oʻzbekchada «mening» oʻzgarmaydi: mening stolim, mening xonam.
Unliga eʼtibor bering: m**ô**j, lekin m**o**ja; n**á**š, lekin n**a**ša. **tvoj** ty bilan, **váš** esa vy bilan ishlatiladi.

en: Your bed is on the left.
**jeho** (his), **jej** (her) and **ich** (their) never change. They go with any noun.
t: **jeho** (uning — erkakning), **jej** (uning — ayolning) va **ich** (ularning) hech qachon oʻzgarmaydi. Ular har qanday ot bilan ishlatiladi. Oʻzbekchada ikkalasi ham «uning», slovakchada esa farqlanadi.

u3-l4.fill-to-je-moja.why.en: Possessives match the gender of the thing owned. Izba is feminine, so **moja**. Watch the vowel: môj for masculine, but moja.
u3-l4.fill-to-je-moja.why.t: Egalik olmoshi narsaning jinsiga moslashadi (oʻzbekchada «mening» oʻzgarmaydi). Izba ayol jinsida, shuning uchun **moja**. Unliga eʼtibor bering: erkak jinsida môj, lekin moja.

u3-l4.fill-kde-je-tvoj.why.en: Stôl is masculine, so it's **tvoj**. Tvoja goes with feminine nouns, tvoje with neuter ones.
u3-l4.fill-kde-je-tvoj.why.t: Stôl erkak jinsida, shuning uchun **tvoj**. Tvoja ayol jinsidagi, tvoje esa oʻrta jinsdagi otlar bilan keladi.

en: Kuchyňa is feminine, so “our” is **naša**. Watch the vowel: náš for masculine, but naša.
Possessives match the thing owned. Kuchyňa is feminine, so **naša**. Naše goes with neuter nouns like okno.
t: Kuchyňa ayol jinsida, shuning uchun «bizning» — **naša**. Unliga eʼtibor bering: erkak jinsida náš, lekin naša.
Egalik olmoshi narsaga moslashadi, oʻzbekchadagi «bizning» esa oʻzgarmaydi. Kuchyňa ayol jinsida: **naša**. Naše esa okno kabi oʻrta jinsdagi otlar uchun.

u3-l4.listen-jeho-postel-je.en.en: His bed is on the left.

en: **Čí?** means whose. It matches the gender of the thing too: **čí** (masculine), **čia** (feminine), **čie** (neuter).
A short answer is just the possessive: Môj. Jej. Naše.
t: **Čí?** — «kimniki?». U ham narsaning jinsiga moslashadi: **čí** (erkak jinsi), **čia** (ayol jinsi), **čie** (oʻrta jins).
Qisqa javob — faqat egalik olmoshining oʻzi: Môj. Jej. Naše. (Meniki. Uniki. Bizniki.)

u3-l4.fill-cia-je-to.why.en: **Čí?** matches the thing it asks about. Posteľ is feminine, even without -a, so **čia**.
u3-l4.fill-cia-je-to.why.t: **Čí?** soʻralayotgan narsaga moslashadi. Posteľ -a bilan tugamasa ham ayol jinsida, shuning uchun **čia**.

u3-l4.choice-moja.question.en: “Čia je to skriňa?” Which answer fits?
u3-l4.choice-moja.question.t: «Čia je to skriňa?» Qaysi javob mos keladi?

u3-l4.choice-moja.why.en: The short answer keeps the gender of the thing: skriňa is feminine, so **moja**, just like čia. Môj is masculine, moje neuter.
u3-l4.choice-moja.why.t: Qisqa javob narsaning jinsini saqlaydi: skriňa ayol jinsida, shuning uchun **moja**, xuddi čia kabi. Môj erkak jinsi, moje esa oʻrta jins uchun.

en: **Čí?** matches the thing it asks about. Okno ends in -o, so it's neuter: **čie**. Čí is for masculine nouns.
Okno is neuter, so “whose” is **čie**. Čia goes with feminine nouns like posteľ.
t: **Čí?** soʻralayotgan narsaga moslashadi. Okno -o bilan tugaydi, demak oʻrta jinsda: **čie**. Čí erkak jinsidagi otlar uchun.
Okno oʻrta jinsda, shuning uchun «kimning» — **čie**. Čia esa posteľ kabi ayol jinsidagi otlar bilan keladi.

u3-l4.fill-lucia-kde-je.why.en: Possessives match the thing owned. Skriňa is feminine, so **tvoja**. Tvoj goes with masculine nouns, tvoje with neuter ones.
u3-l4.fill-lucia-kde-je.why.t: Egalik olmoshi narsaga moslashadi. Skriňa ayol jinsida, shuning uchun **tvoja**. Tvoj erkak jinsidagi, tvoje oʻrta jinsdagi otlar bilan keladi.

u3-l4.fill-pani-horvathova-je.en.en: Mrs Horváthová, is this your lamp?

u3-l4.fill-pani-horvathova-je.why.en: You say vy to a teacher, so “your” is **vaša** (feminine, for lampa). Tvoja goes with ty, for friends.
u3-l4.fill-pani-horvathova-je.why.t: Oʻqituvchiga vy (siz) deyiladi, shuning uchun «sizning» — **vaša** (lampa ayol jinsida). Tvoja esa «sening», ty bilan, doʻstlarga.

en: “Their” is **ich**, and like jeho and jej it never changes: ich izba. Jej means her.
Upstairs is **hore**. Dole is its opposite, downstairs.
t: «Ularning» — **ich**, u ham jeho va jej kabi hech qachon oʻzgarmaydi: ich izba. Jej esa «uning» (ayolning).

u3-l5.byt.note.en: Marek, Lucia's brother, has a new flat. Byt is masculine: nov**ý** byt.
u3-l5.byt.note.t: Lusiyaning akasi Marekning yangi kvartirasi bor. Byt erkak jinsida: nov**ý** byt.

u3-l5.podte-dalej.note.en: To two or more people, or formally. To one friend: **Poď ďalej!**
u3-l5.podte-dalej.note.t: Ikki yoki undan koʻp odamga yoki hurmat bilan aytiladi. Bitta doʻstga: **Poď ďalej!**

u3-l5.choice-podte-dalej.question.en: Marek opens the door for Emma and Lucia. What does he say?
u3-l5.choice-podte-dalej.question.t: Marek Emma va Lusiyaga eshikni ochdi. U nima deydi?

u3-l5.choice-podte-dalej.why.en: Marek is talking to two people, so he uses the vy form, with **-te**: Poď**te** ďalej! = Come in! To one friend it's Poď ďalej!
u3-l5.choice-podte-dalej.why.t: Marek ikki kishiga gapiryapti, shuning uchun **-te** bilan vy shaklini ishlatadi: Poď**te** ďalej! = Kiring! Bitta doʻstga Poď ďalej! deyiladi.

u3-l5.obyvacka.note.en: The full name is **obývacia izba**. Obývací is a soft adjective: it ends in **-í, -ia, -ie**, not -ý, -á, -é.
u3-l5.obyvacka.note.t: Toʻliq nomi — **obývacia izba**. Obývací — yumshoq sifat: u -ý, -á, -é emas, **-í, -ia, -ie** bilan tugaydi.

u3-l5.v-strede-je.en.en: The hallway is in the middle.

u3-l5.fill-chodba-je-v.en.en: The hallway is in the middle.

u3-l5.listen-spalna-je-vlavo.en.en: The bedroom is on the left and the living room on the right.
u3-l5.listen-spalna-je-vlavo.en.t: Yotoq xonasi chapda, mehmonxona esa oʻngda.

u3-l5.svetly-tmavy.note.en: svetl**á** izba = a bright room, full of light
u3-l5.svetly-tmavy.note.t: svetl**á** izba = yorugʻ xona, yorugʻlikka toʻla

u3-l5.fill-obyvacka-je-velka.en.en: The living room is big and bright.

u3-l5.fill-obyvacka-je-velka.why.en: Obývačka is feminine (it ends in -a), so both adjectives take **-á**: veľká a svetl**á**.
u3-l5.fill-obyvacka-je-velka.why.t: Obývačka ayol jinsida (-a bilan tugaydi), shuning uchun ikkala sifat ham **-á** oladi: veľká a svetl**á**.

en: The flat is nice but expensive.
The apartment is nice but expensive.
The flat is pretty but expensive.
Chodba ends in -a, so it's feminine and the adjective takes **-á**, after je too: tmav**á**. Tmavý is for masculine nouns.
Dark is **tmavá**. Svetlá has the right feminine ending, but it means bright, the opposite.
t: Chodba -a bilan tugaydi, demak ayol jinsida, sifat esa je soʻzidan keyin ham **-á** oladi: tmav**á**. Tmavý erkak jinsidagi otlar uchun.
«Qorongʻi» — **tmavá**. Svetlá ham ayol jinsi qoʻshimchasini olgan, lekin u «yorugʻ» degani, yaʼni teskarisi.

u3-l5.fill-byt-nie-je.en.en: The flat isn't expensive, it's cheap.

u3-l5.fill-byt-nie-je.why.en: Byt is masculine (it ends in a consonant), so the adjective takes **-ý**: lacn**ý**, just like drahý.
u3-l5.fill-byt-nie-je.why.t: Byt erkak jinsida (undosh bilan tugaydi), shuning uchun sifat **-ý** oladi: lacn**ý**, xuddi drahý kabi.

en: **Ktorý?** asks which one. It changes like an adjective: **ktorý** (masculine), **ktorá** (feminine), **ktoré** (neuter).
To answer, point with **ten**, **tá**, **to** (that one). Add **-to** for “this one here”: tento, táto, toto.
t: **Ktorý?** — «qaysi biri?». U sifat kabi oʻzgaradi: **ktorý** (erkak jinsi), **ktorá** (ayol jinsi), **ktoré** (oʻrta jins).
Javob berganda **ten**, **tá**, **to** (ana u) bilan koʻrsatiladi. «Mana bu» deyish uchun **-to** qoʻshiladi: tento, táto, toto.

en: Which desk is yours? – The one on the left.
Which bed is mine? – The one on the right.

u3-l6.fill-ktora-izba-je.why.en: **Ktorý?** changes like an adjective. Izba is feminine, so **ktorá**.
u3-l6.fill-ktora-izba-je.why.t: **Ktorý?** sifat kabi oʻzgaradi. Izba ayol jinsida, shuning uchun **ktorá**.

u3-l6.fill-ktory-stol-je.en.en: Which desk is mine? – The one at the front.

u3-l6.fill-ktory-stol-je.why.en: Point with the word that matches the noun: stôl is masculine, so **ten**. Tá is for feminine nouns, to for neuter ones.
u3-l6.fill-ktory-stol-je.why.t: Otga mos koʻrsatish soʻzini tanlang: stôl erkak jinsida, shuning uchun **ten**. Tá ayol jinsidagi, to oʻrta jinsdagi otlar uchun.

u3-l6.choice-ta-vlavo.question.en: Lucia asks: “Ktorá lampa je tvoja?” Emma's lamp is on the left. What does Emma say?
u3-l6.choice-ta-vlavo.question.t: Lusiya soʻraydi: «Ktorá lampa je tvoja?» Emmaning chirogʻi chapda. Emma nima deydi?

u3-l6.choice-ta-vlavo.why.en: Lampa is feminine, so Emma points with **tá**, matching ktorá. Ten is masculine, to is neuter.
u3-l6.choice-ta-vlavo.why.t: Lampa ayol jinsida, shuning uchun Emma ktorá kabi **tá** bilan koʻrsatadi. Ten erkak jinsi, to esa oʻrta jins uchun.

u3-l6.fill-ktore-okno-toto.why.en: Okno is neuter, so the pointing word is to; for “this one here”, add -to: **toto**. Tento is masculine, táto feminine.
u3-l6.fill-ktore-okno-toto.why.t: Okno oʻrta jinsda, shuning uchun koʻrsatish soʻzi to; «mana bu» uchun -to qoʻshiladi: **toto**. Tento erkak jinsi, táto ayol jinsi uchun.

en: **Ktorý?** changes like an adjective. Okno ends in -o, so it's neuter: **ktoré**. Ktorý is for masculine nouns.
Okno is neuter, so “our” is **naše**, just like ktoré. Naša goes with feminine nouns.
t: **Ktorý?** sifat kabi oʻzgaradi. Okno -o bilan tugaydi, demak oʻrta jinsda: **ktoré**. Ktorý erkak jinsidagi otlar uchun.
Okno oʻrta jinsda, shuning uchun «bizniki» — **naše**, xuddi ktoré kabi. Naša ayol jinsidagi otlar bilan keladi.

en: To say whose, Slovak turns the name into an adjective. Men's names add **-ov**: Tomáš → Tomáš**ov**. Women's names drop the final -a and add **-in**: Emm**a** → Emm**in**, Luci**a** → Luci**in**.
Then add the ending for the thing owned: nothing for masculine, **-a** for feminine, **-o** for neuter.
t: «Kimniki» deyish uchun slovak tilida ism sifatga aylantiriladi (oʻzbekchadagi «-ning» oʻrniga). Erkaklar ismiga **-ov** qoʻshiladi: Tomáš → Tomáš**ov**. Ayollar ismida oxirgi -a tushib qoladi va **-in** qoʻshiladi: Emm**a** → Emm**in**, Luci**a** → Luci**in**.
Keyin narsaning jinsiga qarab qoʻshimcha qoʻshiladi: erkak jinsi uchun hech narsa, ayol jinsi uchun **-a**, oʻrta jins uchun **-o**.

en: Lucia's bed is on the left.

u3-l6.fill-to-je-tomasov.why.en: Byt is masculine, so Tomášov takes no ending: **Tomášov**. Tomášova goes with feminine nouns, Tomášovo with neuter ones.
u3-l6.fill-to-je-tomasov.why.t: Byt erkak jinsida, shuning uchun Tomášov qoʻshimcha olmaydi: **Tomášov**. Tomášova ayol jinsidagi, Tomášovo oʻrta jinsdagi otlar bilan keladi.

u3-l6.fill-luciina-postel-je.en.en: Lucia's bed is on the left.

u3-l6.fill-luciina-postel-je.why.en: Posteľ is feminine, even without -a, so Luciin adds **-a**: Luciin**a**.
u3-l6.fill-luciina-postel-je.why.t: Posteľ -a bilan tugamasa ham ayol jinsida, shuning uchun Luciin soʻziga **-a** qoʻshiladi: Luciin**a**.

u3-l6.choice-emmina-izba.why.en: Women's names drop -a and add **-in**: Emma → Emmin. Izba is feminine, so add -a: Emmin**a**. -ov is for men's names.
u3-l6.choice-emmina-izba.why.t: Ayollar ismida -a tushib qoladi va **-in** qoʻshiladi: Emma → Emmin. Izba ayol jinsida, shuning uchun yana -a qoʻshiladi: Emmin**a**. -ov esa erkaklar ismi uchun.

en: Emmin takes the ending of the thing owned. Posteľ is feminine, even without -a, so add **-a**: Emmin**a**.
**Ktorý?** changes like an adjective. Posteľ is feminine, even without -a, so **ktorá**.
t: Emmin narsaning jinsiga qarab qoʻshimcha oladi. Posteľ -a bilan tugamasa ham ayol jinsida, shuning uchun **-a** qoʻshiladi: Emmin**a**.
**Ktorý?** sifat kabi oʻzgaradi. Posteľ -a bilan tugamasa ham ayol jinsida, shuning uchun **ktorá**.

u3-l6.fill-aky-je-byt.en.en: What's the flat like? – Big and bright.

u3-l6.fill-aky-je-byt.why.en: The answer says what the flat is like, so the question is **Aký?** Ktorý asks which one, čí asks whose.
u3-l6.fill-aky-je-byt.why.t: Javob kvartira qandayligini aytyapti, demak savol — **Aký?** Ktorý «qaysi biri?», čí esa «kimniki?» deb soʻraydi.

u3-l7.fill-nasa-kuchyna-je.why.en: Kuchyňa is feminine, so the adjective takes **-á**: mal**á**, like naša before it.
u3-l7.fill-nasa-kuchyna-je.why.t: Kuchyňa ayol jinsida, shuning uchun sifat **-á** oladi: mal**á**, oldidagi naša kabi.

u3-l7.listen-vratnica-je-dole.en.en: The front desk is downstairs, on the left.

u3-l7.choice-cia-je-to.why.en: **Čia** is a form of čí?, whose. Which? would be ktorá, and what is it like? would be aká.
u3-l7.choice-cia-je-to.why.t: **Čia** — čí? (kimniki?) soʻzining shakli. «Qaysi?» ktorá, «qanday?» esa aká boʻlardi.

en: Izba is feminine, so “my” is **moja**. Watch the vowel: môj for masculine, but moja.
Upstairs is **hore**. Dole is its opposite, downstairs.
t: Izba ayol jinsida, shuning uchun «mening» — **moja**. Unliga eʼtibor bering: erkak jinsida môj, lekin moja.

u3-l7.fill-ktory-stol-je.why.en: Stôl is masculine, so **tvoj**, just like ktorý. Tvoja goes with feminine nouns, tvoje with neuter ones.
u3-l7.fill-ktory-stol-je.why.t: Stôl erkak jinsida, shuning uchun **tvoj**, xuddi ktorý kabi. Tvoja ayol jinsidagi, tvoje oʻrta jinsdagi otlar bilan keladi.

en: Tomáš's flat is big and bright.
Tomáš's apartment is big and bright.

u3-l7.fill-kde-je-emmina.why.en: Lampa is feminine, so Emmin adds **-a**: Emmin**a**.
u3-l7.fill-kde-je-emmina.why.t: Lampa ayol jinsida, shuning uchun Emmin soʻziga **-a** qoʻshiladi: Emmin**a**.

u3-l7.choice-mala-a-tmava.question.t: «Aká je izba?» savoliga qaysi javob mos keladi?

u3-l7.choice-mala-a-tmava.why.en: **Aká?** asks what the room is like, so the answer describes it. Tá vľavo answers ktorá (which one), and Moja answers čia (whose).
u3-l7.choice-mala-a-tmava.why.t: **Aká?** xona qandayligini soʻraydi, shuning uchun javob uni tasvirlaydi. Tá vľavo — ktorá (qaysi biri?) savoliga, Moja esa čia (kimniki?) savoliga javob.

en: Okno is neuter, so “which” is **ktoré**. Ktorý goes with masculine nouns.
Okno is neuter, so “your” is **tvoje**, like ktoré. Tvoj goes with masculine nouns.
t: Okno oʻrta jinsda, shuning uchun «qaysi» — **ktoré**. Ktorý erkak jinsidagi otlar bilan keladi.
Okno oʻrta jinsda, shuning uchun «seniki» — **tvoje**, xuddi ktoré kabi. Tvoj erkak jinsidagi otlar bilan keladi.

u3-l7.fill-ktora-postel-je.en.en: Which bed is Lucia's? – The one on the right.

u3-l7.fill-ktora-postel-je.why.en: The answer points to one bed, tá vpravo, so the question is which one. Posteľ is feminine: **ktorá**.
u3-l7.fill-ktora-postel-je.why.t: Javob bitta karavotni koʻrsatyapti (tá vpravo), demak savol «qaysi biri?». Posteľ ayol jinsida: **ktorá**.

u3-l7.fill-pani-horvathova-je.en.en: Mrs Horváthová, is this your desk?

u3-l7.fill-pani-horvathova-je.why.en: Stôl is masculine, so **váš**. Vaša and vaše go with feminine and neuter nouns. It's váš, not tvoj, because you say vy to a teacher.
u3-l7.fill-pani-horvathova-je.why.t: Stôl erkak jinsida, shuning uchun **váš**. Vaša va vaše ayol va oʻrta jinsdagi otlar bilan keladi. Oʻqituvchiga vy deyilgani uchun tvoj emas, váš.

u3-l7.build-kupelna-je-vpravo.prompt.en: The bathroom is on the right and the kitchen is at the back.

en: On the right is **vpravo**. Vľavo is its opposite, on the left.
At the back is **vzadu**. Vpredu is its opposite, at the front.
